settings.title: Settings
settings.language_desc: Choose your preferred language. The interface will switch immediately.
settings.theme_desc: Switch between dark and light appearance.
settings.backup_desc: Download a full backup of the database or configure automatic backups.

pos.title: Point of Sale
pos.image_upload_failed: Sale created but payment image upload failed
pos.tap_size_hint: Tap a size to add it to the cart.
pos.walkin_must_pay: A walk-in customer must pay in full. Pick a customer to sell on account.
pos.undo_confirm: Undo sale {number}? The items go back into stock.
pos.selling_code_hint: This branch asks who made the sale.

sales.title: Sales History
sales.void_confirm: Void this sale? Every item goes back into stock.

products.title: Products
products.add_colors_first: Please add colors to the product first before using the generator.
products.preview_description: You can assign standard US/UK/CM sizing to specific variants before saving, or delete ones you don't need.
products.no_store_prices: No store-specific prices. All stores use the default prices above.
products.add_color_first: Add a color first, then add size variants.
products.select_at_least_one_color: Please select at least one color
products.valid_size_range: Please enter a valid size range (e.g. 38 to 45)
products.confirm_delete_color: Delete this color and all its images?
products.matrix_hint: Tick the combinations you stock. Existing ones are already filled in.
products.no_sizes_product: This product has no sizes — one item per colour.
products.size_not_in_list: That size is not in this category's list

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.category_no_sizes: Products in this category have no size.
inventory.numeric_only_hint: A number range matches numeric sizes only. Pick a category to filter word sizes such as Kids or M.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this invoice?
purchases.suggestion_from: Last time on {invoice}: same cost and {items} items. Use it as a starting point?
purchases.suggestion_applied: Filled from the last box — edit anything you need to

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.no_invoices: No purchase invoices recorded for this supplier.
suppliers.no_payments: No payments have been recorded for this supplier.
suppliers.payment_allocation_note: Any payment recorded here will automatically be allocated to the oldest unpaid invoices first (FIFO). If the payment exceeds the owed amount, the remaining funds will be stored as an Advance Payment on the supplier's account balance.
suppliers.withdrawal_note: Withdraw money owed to you by this supplier. Maximum available:
suppliers.deactivate_confirm: They will stop appearing when receiving stock. Their history is kept.

returns.title: Returns
returns.search_sale_placeholder: Sale number (S-...), customer phone or name, or the product
returns.no_sales_found: No sales found matching that query.
returns.all_items_already_returned: All items in this sale have already been returned.
returns.select_at_least_one: Please select at least one item to return
returns.filter_placeholder: Filter by product, SKU, or color...
returns.no_inventory_found: No active inventory found from this supplier.
returns.supplier_reason_placeholder: e.g. Defective, Wrong Size, Poor Quality...

dealers.title: Dealers
dealers.deactivate_confirm: They will stop appearing on new invoices. Their history is kept.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.page_total_note: Total is for every matching expense, not just this page
expenses.delete_confirm: Delete this expense? Its receipts go with it.
expenses.paid_from_drawer_hint: Tick only if the cash physically came out of the drawer. It is then subtracted at cash-up.

stores.title: Stores
stores.page_hint: Every branch: what it holds, what it sold and what it made. Open one to see its report, stock, staff and prices.
stores.is_warehouse_hint: Warehouses hold stock and normally do not sell.
stores.is_open_hint: Closing a branch hides it from the till and from transfers. A branch that still holds stock cannot be closed.
stores.owed_hint: Sold on account, not yet settled
stores.no_figures: Figures are not available for this branch
stores.overview_hint: How this branch performed over the chosen period. Profit is what the goods made after cost; net is that profit less this branch’s expenses.
stores.stock_hint: Every colour and size sitting in this branch right now.
stores.staff_hint: Who works here. Assigning somebody to a branch lets them see its sales, stock and takings, so this needs permission to manage users.
stores.pricing_hint: What this branch charges. Leave a row empty and it sells at the catalogue price; set one and only this branch changes.
stores.home_store_note: A home branch comes from the user’s own record and is changed on the Users page.

users.title: Users
users.store_access_help: Select which stores {name} can access for POS sales
users.confirm_deactivate: Are you sure you want to deactivate "{name}"?
users.confirm_reactivate: Are you sure you want to reactivate "{name}"?
users.seller_code_hint: The short code {name} types at checkout to claim a sale. It is not a password and cannot sign anyone in.
users.seller_code_rules: 3 to 20 characters, and unique among the staff at their branch.

activity_log.title: Activity Log
activity_log.clear_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all activity history? This action cannot be undone.

reports.title: Reports & Analytics
reports.name: Name
reports.stores_hint: Every branch side by side over the chosen period. The branch filter at the top does not apply here — a comparison narrowed to one branch is a single row.
reports.stores_chart_hint: Revenue is what came in; profit is what the goods made after cost; expenses are what this branch spent.
reports.stores_stock_hint: What each branch is holding, valued at cost.
reports.compared_with: Arrows compare against {from} to {to}, the same length of time immediately before.
reports.overview_hint: The headline figures for the period you picked, with the direction of travel against the period before it.
reports.sales_hint: When sales happen and how discounting affects them — by day, by hour and by weekday.
reports.products_hint: Which products and brands move, and in which sizes. Revenue here is before the sale-level discount; profit has it allocated across the lines.
reports.inventory_hint: What is sitting on the shelves, where it is, and how long it has been there. Anything over 90 days is money not moving.
reports.financial_hint: Money in against money out. Gross profit is revenue less what the goods cost; net profit takes expenses off that too.
reports.customers_hint: Who buys, how often, and how much of the business is walk-in trade.
reports.employees_hint: Sales credited to each person over the period.
reports.hl_revenue_up: Revenue is up {pct}% on the period before, which took {prev}.
reports.hl_revenue_down: Revenue is down {pct}% on the period before, which took {prev}.
reports.hl_low_stock: {n} product(s) are down to their last few pairs.
reports.cost_basis_estimated: {items} of {total} items sold in this period still rest on an estimated cost ({pct}%). These figures will change when those products are next bought on a real invoice.
reports.cost_basis_restated: Restated on {date}: {items} item(s) in this period were re-costed after a real invoice arrived.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.price_update_message: The net purchase cost for {product_code} was updated from {old_price} EGP to {new_price} EGP based on a newly completed purchase invoice box. Please review its selling boundaries to maintain margins.
notifications.delete_confirm: Permanently delete notifications in this date range?
notifications.cost_corrected_message: {pairs} pair(s) of {product_code} were entered with an estimated cost of {old_cost} EGP. That has been replaced with {new_cost} EGP from {invoice_number}. {sold_pairs} of them were already sold, so the profit reported for those days has changed. This is today’s cost, which may not be what you paid for the older stock — undo it if it looks wrong.
notifications.discount_request_message: {who} is asking for {amount} EGP off a {total} EGP sale. {reason}
notifications.topics_hint: What {name} is told about. Turning a topic off hides it from their bell; the history keeps everything.

topic_hints.staff_expense: Somebody other than you recorded an expense
topic_hints.discount_request: A salesperson is asking to give a discount
topic_hints.discount_decision: Your discount request was approved or rejected
topic_hints.credit_request: A customer wants to take goods and pay later
topic_hints.credit_decision: Your pay-later request was approved or rejected
topic_hints.price_update: A supplier invoice changed what a product costs you
topic_hints.cost_corrected: A real invoice replaced an estimated cost, and reports were restated
topic_hints.shift_difference: A cash-up came out short or over
topic_hints.stock_count_posted: A count was posted and stock was written off or found
topic_hints.low_stock: A product is close to running out
topic_hints.transfer_incoming: A transfer is on its way to your branch
topic_hints.loan_due: A loan repayment is due or overdue
topic_hints.supplier_payment: A payment was recorded against a supplier

loans.title: Loans
loans.borrower_hint: Pick a staff member, or type any name — a customer, a driver, a relative.

barcode.nothing_to_print: Nothing to print — set at least one copy
barcode.print_failed: Could not open the print dialog
barcode.tspl_hint: Raw printer commands for sending straight to the TSC printer
barcode.missing_hint: They cannot be printed until a barcode is generated for them.
barcode.point_at_code: Point the camera at the barcode
barcode.take_photo: Take a photo of the barcode
barcode.upload_hint: Opens your camera on a phone, or choose an existing image.
barcode.cam_denied: Camera permission was refused. Allow it in your browser settings, or use a photo instead.
barcode.cam_none: No camera found on this device. Use a photo instead.
barcode.cam_insecure: Live camera needs a secure (HTTPS) connection. Taking a photo still works.
barcode.cam_failed: The camera could not be started. Use a photo instead.
barcode.no_code_in_image: No barcode found in that image. Try again closer, straighter, and in better light.
barcode.not_an_image: That file is not an image.
barcode.scan_hint: Scan a barcode, or use the camera button
barcode.link_hint: Type or scan the barcode already printed on the box.
barcode.nothing_to_label: Nothing to label — no items match the current filter.
barcode.test_print_hint: Prints a single label so you can check the printer settings without wasting a roll.
barcode.setup_stock: Windows → Printers → your label printer → Printing preferences: create a stock of exactly {size} and set it as the default.
barcode.setup_scale: More settings → Scale: 100 (not "Default" or "Fit to printable area" — those shrink the barcode) and Margins: None.
barcode.setup_rotated: Only if it still comes out sideways after all that: change Orientation above and print another test label — try both turn directions, one of them comes out straight.
barcode.setup_title: Printer setup — do this once for each till
barcode.setup_why: The label only comes out right when the print dialog is actually using the label stock. On any other paper size Chrome shrinks the barcode, prints its own header, and lets the driver turn the label sideways onto two stickers.
barcode.setup_paper: In the print dialog set Destination to the label printer, then More settings → Paper size to that {size} stock. This is the one that matters most.
barcode.setup_headers: Untick "Headers and footers", or the date, page number and web address get printed on your label.
barcode.setup_hide: Hide — this till is set up

categories.title: Categories & sizes
categories.subtitle: What a product can have: its sizes, and whether it uses colours at all.
categories.code_hint: A short identifier, lowercase, no spaces. It cannot be changed later.
categories.has_colors: Products in this category come in colours
categories.has_sizes: Products in this category come in sizes
categories.size_list_hint: Every product in this category offers exactly these sizes.
categories.no_sizes_note: Products here have no size. Each colour is a single sellable item.
categories.no_colors_note: Products here have no colour. Images attach to the product itself.
categories.in_use_cannot_remove: In use — deactivate instead of removing
categories.range_hint: Numeric lists sort themselves — type a range (e.g. 19 to 49, step 0.5) and Generate.
categories.range_invalid: Enter a valid range: From must be ≤ To and Step greater than 0.
categories.range_too_many: That range would create too many sizes (limit 400).
categories.range_all_exist: Those sizes are already in the list.
categories.prefix_hint: Printed before the size, e.g. EU 42
categories.suffix_hint: Printed after the size, e.g. 95 cm
categories.is_numeric_hint: Enables the size range filter and the US/UK/CM columns.
categories.escape_codes_used: {used} of {max} barcode slots used for non-numeric sizes
categories.shape_locked: Sizes and colours cannot be changed once products use this category.

expcat.title: Expense categories
expcat.subtitle: Name your own costs, and group them two levels deep.
expcat.two_levels_note: A sub-category cannot hold sub-categories of its own.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.subtitle: Rent, salaries and anything else that comes round again. Nothing posts by itself — you confirm each one.

budget.title: Budgets
budget.subtitle: Set a monthly limit per category and watch the variance.

intake.title: Stock entry
intake.page_hint: Put stock into a branch without a purchase invoice — opening stock, a shop count, or goods found or written off. It creates stock only: no supplier is owed anything.
intake.detail_hint: A draft changes nothing. Posting is the moment the stock exists.
intake.no_store: You are not assigned to a branch
intake.believed_supplier_note: A note only. No invoice is created and nothing is owed.
intake.hint_real: We already have a real cost: {cost} EGP from {source}
intake.hint_none: No invoiced cost on record for this product yet.
intake.fill_from_price: Or work it back from the selling price at
intake.i_know_this_cost: I know this cost — it is not a guess
intake.known_note: Treated like an invoiced cost. Nothing will ever overwrite it.
intake.guess_note: Marked as a guess. It will be replaced automatically the next time this product arrives on a real invoice, and you will be told.
intake.nothing_to_add: Type at least one quantity first
intake.no_selling_price: This product has no selling price to work back from
intake.post_note: Posting creates one pair per unit and cannot be edited afterwards. It can be reversed while nothing has sold.
intake.reversed_ok: Reversed. The stock it created has been removed.
intake.banner: {pairs} pair(s) in stock still have a guessed cost, and {sold} already sold. Profit figures that include them are provisional.
intake.estimated_hint: Costs that are still a guess. Each is replaced automatically when that product next arrives on a real invoice — but stock you never buy again will stay a guess, so set it by hand here.
intake.nothing_guessed: Nothing is resting on a guess.
intake.recost_prompt: New cost per pair for {product} ({pairs} pair(s)):
intake.recost_still_guess:
Is this still a guess?

OK  = still a guess, a future invoice may replace it.
Cancel = this is the real cost, never overwrite it.
intake.corrections_hint: Every time a real invoice replaced a guess. The invoiced cost is today’s cost, and the stock may have been bought long ago at a different price — so undo anything that looks wrong.
intake.undo_confirm: Put these costs back to what they were? Any profit figures that moved will move back.
intake.recost_title: Set the cost for this product
intake.delete_confirm: This draft has not been posted, so no stock will change. It cannot be recovered.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.optional_hint: Show it to the customer, or print it. Nothing prints on its own.

shifts.title: Till & cash-up
shifts.page_hint: Start the day by counting the drawer, and end it by counting the drawer. What is in between is the difference.
shifts.no_open_shift: No shift is open at this branch
shifts.no_open_hint: You can still sell — but that cash belongs to no cash-up, and nothing will check it.
shifts.count_the_float: What is in the drawer now
shifts.float_hint: Count it. This is the figure everything tonight is measured against.
shifts.float_required: Enter what is in the drawer
shifts.count_first_hint: Count the drawer first, then enter it. The expected figure is shown afterwards, on purpose.
shifts.non_cash_note: Card, transfer and on-account money is not in the drawer: {amount} EGP this shift.
shifts.move_owner_take_hint: Money you are taking out of the till now.
shifts.move_drop_hint: Moved out of the drawer for safekeeping during the shift.
shifts.move_float_in_hint: Small notes and coins put in so the till can give change.
shifts.move_correction_hint: Only when something was recorded wrongly. Say why.
shifts.unassigned_warning: {amount} EGP of cash was taken at this branch with no shift open, across {n} payment(s). That money belongs to no cash-up.
shifts.open_here: Till open · {number} · about {amount} EGP in the drawer
shifts.none_open_here: No till is open. Cash taken now belongs to no cash-up.
shifts.recount_hint: The shift stays closed and no new sales can land in it. Only what was counted changes — what was expected stays as it was recorded.
shifts.recounted_amount: What was actually in the drawer

exchange.title: Exchanges
exchange.page_hint: Take something back and give something else — another size, or a completely different product.
exchange.find_sale: Receipt number, phone, name or product
exchange.find_sale_hint: Search a receipt number, a customer name or phone, or the product itself — brand, model, code or colour. Or scan the label still on the shoe.
exchange.any_product_hint: Any product in this branch — it does not have to be the same one.
exchange.going_out_hint: Scan it, or search. It does not have to be the same product, and the price may be higher or lower.
exchange.scan_no_sale: No sale found for that label
exchange.detail_hint: The return and the new sale were recorded together.

count.title: Stock take
count.page_hint: Count the shelf and face the difference. Missing stock is written off; extra stock is added.
count.new_hint: The expected numbers are frozen the moment the sheet is made, so a busy afternoon does not read as shrinkage.
count.only_uncounted: Only what is still to count
count.frozen_hint: Expected quantities were frozen when this sheet was made.
count.post_confirm: Post this count? Missing stock is written off and extra stock is added. This cannot be undone.
count.posted_note: This count has been posted. Run another count to correct it.

discount.ask_hint: A manager has to approve this. The cart total is {total} EGP.
discount.no_hold_warning: The stock is not held while you wait — it can still be sold to somebody else.
discount.too_big: That is more than the cart
discount.queue_hint: What staff are asking for, and what it is worth. You can approve less than was asked.
discount.decide_hint: {who} is asking for {asked} EGP off a {total} EGP sale.
discount.approve_less_hint: Change it to approve less than was asked.
discount.below_min_warning: This is {amount} EGP under what these items are allowed to sell for.
discount.below_min_blocked: That leaves {after} EGP against a {min} EGP minimum — {shortfall} EGP under. Approve anyway?

reorder.hint: Based on what actually sold in the last {window} days, and enough stock to cover {target} days.
reorder.buy_hint: Ranked by how long the shelf lasts, not by how many are left.
reorder.dead_hint: Nothing sold in {days} days. This is money sitting on a shelf.
reorder.overstock_hint: More than four months of cover at the current rate.

pages.title: Pages shown
pages.hint: Which screens {name} sees in the menu.
pages.not_a_permission: This tidies the menu. It does not lock anything: what a person can actually reach is decided by their permissions.
pages.admin_note: This person is an admin, so nothing is hidden from them.
pages.already_unreachable: No {perm} permission, so this is already out of reach

credit.queue_hint: A customer wants to take goods now and pay later. Approving puts the amount on their account.
credit.approve_less_hint: You can approve less than was asked. The rest has to be paid at the counter.
credit.decide_hint: {who} is asking to let {customer} take {total} EGP of goods and leave {asked} EGP unpaid.
credit.ask_title: Ask to let this customer pay later
credit.ask_hint: The sale is {total}. How much may the customer leave unpaid? A manager has to agree before the goods go out.
credit.needs_customer: Choose the customer first. There has to be someone to collect from.
credit.over_approved: Only {amount} was approved to be left unpaid.
